description: Calculates optimal lowest-slippage bridge routes across EVM chains and Solana.

amount.description: Amount of token units to route across chains.

from_chain.description: Source blockchain identifier (e.g. base, arbitrum, ethereum).

from_token.description: Asset symbol or contract address being bridged from.

to_chain.description: Destination blockchain identifier (e.g. solana, polygon, optimism).

to_token.description: Target asset symbol or contract address.

name: cross_chain_bridge_optimizer

ready_to_sign.description: Whether transaction payload is ready to sign
